name: amxts-vscode
description: Editor support for amxts: live hints and checks for the official modules' files - Menu Core menus and Config Core configs - from the names and shapes your plugins declare.

commands.title: Re-read the names the workspace registers

amxts.menus.files.markdownDescription: More menu files, besides the one `amxts.config.ts` names (`menus.file`, `menus.fallback`): each a name as `menus.file` takes it (`myserver/menu` - any `.ini`, `.yaml`, `.yml`, `.json` or `.jsonc` whose path ends with it) or a file name with its extension (`shop.yaml`).

amxts.menus.detectByContent.markdownDescription: Also treat a file as a menu file when its content looks like one: an INI `[SECTION]` with `TITLE` and `ITEMS` or `VIEW`, a YAML or JSON file with a top-level `menus` key.

amxts.index.excludeFolders.markdownDescription: Folder names skipped when the workspace is searched for registrations (`.ts`, `.sma`). The sources of installed modules - `node_modules/@amxts/*/src` - are read anyway. Test folders are skipped because tests register names of their own.

amxts.diagnostics.unknownNames.markdownDescription: Warn of a condition, action, restriction or placeholder that nothing in the workspace registers. A Pawn plugin on the server that is not in the workspace may still register it.
